description.value: Therapy Vineyards is a boutique winery situated on the Naramata Bench, one of British Columbia's most celebrated wine touring routes. Walk-in tastings are welcome for individuals and small groups, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area. The winery operates its own ecommerce platform and tasting room booking system, suggesting a well-established visitor experience.

address.value: 940 Lower Debeck Road, Naramata, BC V0H 1N1
